items.text: Cardinals RB Jeremiyah Love (ankle) is ACTIVE. Risk/reward RB2; starting him everywhere as team would not activate if major concern. Some residual risk as Cardinals.
items.why: Expected to play per weekend reports; confirmed active by beat.
items.implication: Viable RB2 start with upside if workload materializes.
items.opportunity: RB2 depth chart role; goal-line/third-down potential.

items.text: Bears WR Rome Odunze (calf) is officially ACTIVE vs Panthers.
items.why: Expected per reports; cleared inactive list.
items.implication: Full go in Bears offense; maintain WR rankings.
items.opportunity: Routes and targets as primary option.

items.text: Weekend status summary: Love (ankle) and Odunze (calf) expected to play; Kamara (knee) not expected; Josh Williams activated (Tucker doubtful); Nabers (knee) no news yet.
items.why: Compiled beat/weekend reports heading into inactive window.
items.implication: Core Sunday AM intelligence for lineup locks.

items.text: Saints RB Alvin Kamara (knee/MCL sprain) is not expected to play and was confirmed inactive vs Lions. Full participant late week but not ready.
items.why: MCL sprain; sources say not quite ready despite full practice late week.
items.implication: Major role expansion for remaining Saints RBs in potentially high-pace game.

items.text: Ravens ruled out rookie WR Ja'Kobi Lane due to wrist injury.
items.implication: Minor depth loss; Flowers/Andrews etc unaffected primarily.

items.text: Start Jeremiyah Love everywhere as risk/reward RB2 now that ACTIVE.
items.why: Active status removes major injury worry; Cardinals unlikely to dress if limited.

items.text: Patriots WR AJ Brown will not need surgery on high ankle sprain but sidelined 4-6 weeks.
items.why: High ankle sprain, no surgery required.
items.implication: IR candidate or multi-week absence; handcuff/WR depth needed.
items.opportunity: Increased targets for other NE WRs/TE.

items.text: Roughly all main-slate news locked. No major projection changes expected outside Nabers (Q, knee). Projections live and updating; afternoon-only slate available.
items.why: Inactive window largely complete for 1pm slate.
items.implication: Trust current ETR projections for lineup/DFS locks.

items.text: Raiders TE Brock Bowers OUT (meniscus trim Tuesday). Realistic chance misses only one game and returns Week 2 at LAC; team will monitor this week.
items.implication: Stream TE this week; hold for likely quick return.
items.opportunity: Michael Mayer primary beneficiary for targets.

items.text: Malik Nabers (knee) situation murky for SNF; up to him. Giants elevated WR Braxton Berrios and WR Dalen Cambre from PS. Main slate news locked; projections updating only for Nabers news.
items.why: Full practices but decision left to player post-ACL/meniscus; elevations signal contingency.
items.implication: Hold/start with caution or have SNF/MNF pivot ready; if out, Fields/Mooney/OBJ rise.
items.opportunity: If active, high target share; if out, WR2/3 opportunity.

items.text: Bucs activated RB Josh Williams from PS (Sean Tucker doubtful). Elevated for Week 1 vs CIN.
items.implication: Depth/handcuff elevation in TB backfield behind Irving/others.
items.opportunity: Potential change-of-pace or injury fill-in snaps.

items.text: Buy low on Colston Loveland. Preseason stance of wanting Bears offense exposure unchanged despite Week 1 target competition from Kmet/Raymond.
items.why: Bears offense volume still attractive long-term.
items.implication: Hold/buy after soft Week 1; TE upside remains.

items.text: Dontayvion Wicks (ex-Packers with new OC Sean Mannion) more real than not; heavily discussed preseason and early returns support.
items.why: Scheme fit and early usage validation.

items.text: Steelers CB Joey Porter Jr. officially inactive (back) amid contract dispute; trade possibility remains.
items.implication: Secondary impact for ATL pass game (Bijan/London etc).

items.text: Chuba Hubbard is a viable flex this week; keeping it open on him.
items.implication: Flex start option amid CAR RB committee.

items.text: Pace: NO @ DET up; MIA @ LV slow slog. Full Week 1 snaps & pace available.
items.why: Projected game scripts and historical pace factors.
items.implication: Higher play volume for NO-DET skill players; suppress MIA-LV.
